title: How to choose a trusted provider
content: Finding the right professional is easier when you know what to look for. Check the rating: GIGGO uses a fair, Bayesian rating that blends star ratings with the sentiment of written reviews, so a provider with a handful of reviews is not unfairly boosted over a proven one. Read recent reviews: the sentiment badge summarises how customers felt, so look for consistency, not just a high number. Prefer the verified badge: verified providers have completed identity checks (KYC). Compare the transparent price: every booking shows a full breakdown of base fee, work fee and travel before you confirm.

title: Payments and escrow: how it works
content: GIGGO protects both sides with escrow. When you pay for a completed job, the money is held securely by GIGGO, not sent straight to the provider. Once you are happy with the work, you release it, and the provider is paid out minus a small platform fee. If something is wrong before you release, you can request a refund of the escrowed funds. This keeps payments fair and low risk for everyone.

title: Staying safe with home services
content: A few habits go a long way. Share only what the provider needs: your contact details are used for the job, not marketing. Track arrival in the app: you can follow your provider on the way and see a live ETA. Keep communication and payment on GIGGO, so everything is recorded and protected by escrow. Leave an honest review afterwards, because it helps the whole community.

title: Getting verified as a provider
content: Verified providers stand out and get chosen more often. Head to Profile then Verification and submit your ID document, which can be an NIC, passport or driving licence. Our team reviews it, and once approved the verified badge appears on your profile across GIGGO. Tips: use the exact name on your document, and make sure the number is entered correctly to avoid delays.
